text: Based on satellite evidence, no significant tree-cover loss (events ≥0.5 ha) was detected in this forest between 2021 and 2025. The asset retained at least 91.77% forest cover in 2020 (JRC data) and showed no stand-replacing losses in annual observations through 2025 (Hansen GFC). However, smaller changes (<0.5 ha) or edge disturbances might have gone undetected due to 30m pixel resolution limits. The forest appears largely intact post-2020, but "fully intact" cannot be guaranteed without ground truthing.
